how_it_judges: A measure with gate true fails the comparison when it is worse than the baseline by more than its tolerance; gate false measures are listed when they move and never fail. good says which direction is better; null means no direction is judged. none_is worst means a missing value (an answer no result holds) is worse than any rank.
tolerances: Every measure is exact (tolerance 0) when the run is deterministic: the store stage calls no model, and an ingest stage whose requests all came from the extraction cache repeats the model output behind the baseline. Only an ingest stage that asked the model (live_calls above zero in either report) uses live: the tolerance is the larger of abs and rel times the baseline value. They come from three full live runs on 2026-10-19 (deepseek-v4.1-flash:cloud, Ollama 0.40.6, current main): for each chat and measure the spread between the lowest and highest of the three runs. rel is twice the largest spread over mean for the chats whose mean is at least 10, rounded up to 0.01; abs is twice the largest spread over the other chats, rounded up to a whole count (0.05 for per-turn ratios) and at least 1 for counts. Twice the spread, because three runs show less than the range a fourth can reach; with it, none of the six baseline and candidate pairs among the three runs fails. Rerun the three runs when the model, its server or the prompt changes. The store-extract stage is judged the same way: exact when every request came from the extraction cache, and by the live_by_stage entry of store-extract (in place of live) when it asked the model. Those come from three live runs of that stage on 2026-10-19 (same model and server, current main), by the same rule, from the spread between the lowest and highest of the three; a count of questions or requests that did not move gets 1, because three equal runs are weaker evidence than a spread of zero. The store-session control and the store-extract-session stage have no baseline and no tolerance: memories that share a session break retrieval ties differently from run to run (the rank of one answer moved from 17 to 21 in the control), so they are reports to read, not rules to gate.
